tool.description: Scene management: load, save, create, hierarchy.

action.name: load
action.description: Load a scene by name/path or build index.

action.name: save
action.description: Save the active scene, or a named scene as save-as.

action.name: create
action.description: Create a new scene file.

action.name: get_hierarchy
action.description: Get the hierarchy tree of loaded scenes (large scenes return roots only).

tool.description: Editor control: play-mode transitions (run-to-completion, cover domain reloads), compilation, refresh, wait-for-idle, tags/layers, windows, focus, selection, editor state.

action.name: play
action.description: Enter play mode (run-to-completion; returns after the switch, incl. domain reload).

action.name: stop
action.description: Exit play mode (run-to-completion).

action.name: pause
action.description: Pause or unpause play mode.

action.name: resume
action.description: Resume play mode, or step exactly one frame.
action.param: true = step one frame; false = resume

action.name: step
action.description: Step one frame in play mode.

action.name: get_state
action.description: Get the full editor state snapshot: play mode, compiling, active scene, console errors, policy flags.

action.name: get_current_state
action.description: Alias of get_state.

action.name: refresh
action.description: Refresh the asset database and wait for imports + compilation (blocked in Play Mode).

action.name: request_compile
action.description: Compile scripts and return console diagnostics (run-to-completion).
action.param: Include console diagnostics in the response

action.name: start_compilation_pipeline
action.description: Alias of request_compile.

action.name: get_compilation_summary
action.description: Error/warning counts of the most recent compilation.

action.name: wait_for_idle
action.description: Wait until every Bridge job has finished and the editor is idle.
action.param: Give up after this many seconds

action.name: get_tags
action.description: List all project tags.

action.name: ensure_tag
action.description: Create a tag if it does not exist (idempotent).

action.name: add_tag
action.description: Create a tag (errors if it already exists).

action.name: remove_tag
action.description: Delete a tag.

action.name: get_layers
action.description: List all named layers.

action.name: ensure_layer
action.description: Create a layer if it does not exist (idempotent).

action.name: add_layer
action.description: Create a layer (errors if it already exists).

action.name: remove_layer
action.description: Delete a layer.

action.name: get_windows
action.description: List open editor windows.

action.name: focus_window
action.description: Focus an editor window by type name.

action.name: get_selection
action.description: Current selection (objects/assets + hierarchy paths).

action.name: get_active_tool
action.description: Get the active editor tool (Move/Rotate/Scale/...).

action.name: set_active_tool
action.description: Set the active editor tool.
action.param: Tool name, e.g. Move, Rotate, Scale

action.name: get_project_root
action.description: Get the Tuanjie project root path.

action.name: drain_agent_input
action.description: Drain pending editor→agent input messages.

action.name: publish_dirty_state_if_needed
action.description: Deprecated: use get_state.

action.name: wait_for_compile
action.description: Deprecated: every command returns only after its work completes.

action.name: wait_for_stop
action.description: Deprecated: every command returns only after its work completes.

tool.description: GameObject operations: create, find, modify, delete, components, children.

action.name: find
action.description: Find GameObjects by target (name, hierarchy path, or instanceID) or by a fuzzy searchTerm.
action.param: Fuzzy case-insensitive name filter (contains); overrides target when both are sent
Include inactive GameObjects in the search
Return every match instead of the first

action.name: create
action.description: Create a GameObject, optionally a primitive, at a transform, under a parent.

param.name: primitiveType
param.note: cube | sphere | capsule | cylinder | plane | quad

action.name: modify
action.description: Modify a GameObject's transform, identity, or components. Write guard: denied in Play Mode.

action.name: delete
action.description: Delete a GameObject.

action.name: get_components
action.description: List components on a GameObject.

action.name: remove_component
action.description: Remove a component from a GameObject.

action.name: set_component_property
action.description: Set one property on a component.

action.name: list_children
action.description: List the children of a GameObject.

action.name: create_batch
action.description: Create several GameObjects in one call.

action.name: edit_batch
action.description: Edit several GameObjects in one call.

action.name: ensure_component
action.description: Ensure a GameObject has a component (idempotent).

action.name: ensure_renderer_material
action.description: Ensure a renderer's material slot is assigned.

action.name: ensure_mesh_collider_mesh
action.description: Ensure a MeshCollider references the mesh of its MeshFilter.

action.name: ensure_prefab_default_sprite
action.description: Ensure a prefab has a default sprite.

tool.description: Asset database operations: create, modify, search, asset info, prefab variants.

action.name: create
action.description: Create an asset (material, scriptable object, ...).

action.name: modify
action.description: Modify an asset's serialized properties.

action.name: search
action.description: Search the asset database.

action.name: get_info
action.description: Get an asset's metadata.

action.name: ensure_prefab_variant
action.description: Ensure a prefab variant exists (created from the source prefab if missing).

tool.description: Resolve the real 32-character YAML guid of an asset. Tuanjie stores an encrypted guid in .meta files; AssetDatabase.AssetPathToGUID inside the editor is the only authoritative source.

action.name: path_to_guid
action.description: Get the YAML guid for an asset path, optionally verifying it against an expected guid.
action.param: Asset path under Assets/ (file or folder)
Expected guid to verify: a 32-hex value is compared against the YAML guid, anything else against the asset's .meta verbatim

tool.description: Shader operations: compile (run-to-completion), preview, render-pipeline detection, SRP material fixes.

action.name: compile
action.description: Compile shaders and return structured error/warning messages (run-to-completion). Requires at least one of paths/shader_names.
action.param: Shader file paths relative to Assets/ (.shader/.hlsl/.cginc/.glsl/.compute)
Materials whose shaders should be compiled
Passes to include in the warmup

param.name: timeout_seconds
param.note: the client budget scales with it

action.name: preview
action.description: Render a shader preview on a mesh.

tool.description: Read or clear the editor console log (filter by type, format, count); toggle console collapse mode.

action.name: get
action.description: Read captured console entries.
action.param: ISO timestamp; return only newer entries

action.name: clear
action.description: Clear the console.
action.param: "all" clears everything; "errors_only" is accepted but currently also clears all (Unity API limitation)

action.name: set_collapse
action.description: Enable or disable the console Collapse mode (persisted; `get` results respect it — collapsed entries are groups with occurrence counts).

tool.description: Execute an editor menu item by path, or list available menus.

action.name: execute
action.description: Execute an editor menu item by path. Default action when none is given.

action.name: get_available_menus
action.description: List available menu paths (reflection + [MenuItem] scan).

tool.description: Execute C# code with Roslyn (legacy command): inline code or a .cs file path, optional REPL session. No mode-switch budget.
tool.param: Inline C# code (one of script/script_path required)

param.name: timeoutSeconds
param.note: cap 3600; 0 = no deadline; the client budget scales with it

tool.param: Allow scripts that trigger a domain reload
Record Game View MP4 while the script runs: {durationSeconds}
Capture Debug.Log output from the script

tool.description: Execute C# in edit-mode context (Roslyn). May trigger a mode switch or domain reload; the budget covers the default 300 s script timeout plus the 120 s mode-switch window.
tool.param: Inline C# code (one of script/script_path required)

param.name: timeoutSeconds
param.note: cap 3600; 0 = no deadline; the client budget scales with it

tool.param: Allow scripts that trigger a domain reload
Capture Debug.Log output from the script

tool.description: Execute C# in play-mode context (Roslyn). Enters Play Mode first when needed; the budget covers the default 300 s script timeout plus the 120 s mode-switch window.
tool.param: Inline C# code (one of script/script_path required)

param.name: timeoutSeconds
param.note: cap 3600; 0 = no deadline; the client budget scales with it

tool.param: Capture Debug.Log output from the script

tool.description: UPM package management: install/remove/list (run-to-completion; install/remove return after the package resolves and the editor reloaded).

action.name: install_package
action.description: Install a package by id or git URL (run-to-completion; returns after install and resolve).
action.param: Package id, name, or git URL
Server-side budget; the client deadline scales with it

action.name: remove_package
action.description: Remove a package (run-to-completion).
action.param: Server-side budget; the client deadline scales with it

action.name: list_packages
action.description: List installed/resolvable packages.
action.param: Server-side budget; the client deadline scales with it

tool.description: Baking: lighting/navmesh bake (run-to-completion), clear baked data, wait for bake.

action.name: bake_lighting
action.description: Bake lighting (run-to-completion; budget covers the full bake).

action.name: bake_navmesh
action.description: Bake the NavMesh.
action.param: Server-side budget for the waiting path; the client deadline scales with it

action.name: wait_for_bake
action.description: Deprecated: bakes are run-to-completion and return when finished.

action.name: clear_navmesh
action.description: Clear the baked NavMesh data.

action.name: clear_baked_data
action.description: Clear baked lighting data.

tool.description: Run a [CustomTool]-registered custom tool (tool_name + parameters).
List [CustomTool]-registered custom tools with their sources.
Internal descriptor state-dirty flag management.

action.name: notify_file_changed
action.description: Flag a file change in the descriptor state.

action.name: notify_batch_changes
action.description: Flag several file changes at once.

action.name: get_statistics
action.description: State-dirty notification statistics.

tool.description: Internal per-project asset-listening toggle: pause/resume asset refresh broadcasts (the state is broadcast to clients).

action.name: set
action.description: Pause or resume asset listening; the new state is broadcast to every connected client.
action.param: true = pause asset listening, false = resume

action.name: status
action.description: Read the asset-listening state.

tool.description: Editor window management: focus/list, native window resolve, stream server control, window input.

action.name: list_windows
action.description: List editor windows with their types and titles.

action.name: focus_window
action.description: Focus an editor window.

action.name: resolve_native_window
action.description: Resolve the native (OS) window handle info.

action.name: input
action.description: Send an input event to an editor window.

param.name: eventType
param.note: focus | mousemove | mousedown | mouseup | wheel | keydown | keyup | textinput

action.name: start_stream_server
action.description: Start the window stream server.

action.name: stop_stream_server
action.description: Stop the window stream server.

action.name: get_stream_server_status
action.description: Query the stream server status.

action.name: start_offscreen_stream
action.description: Start an offscreen window stream.

action.name: stop_offscreen_stream
action.description: Stop an offscreen stream.

tool.description: Game View resolution control: get/list/set.

action.name: get_resolution
action.description: Get the currently selected Game View resolution.

action.name: list_resolutions
action.description: List all resolutions in the current size group.

action.name: set_resolution
action.description: Select (or create) a fixed Game View resolution.

tool.description: Screenshots (scene view, cameras, assets, UI Toolkit; PNG or animated GIF) and Game View MP4 recording (start/finish).

action.name: capture_scene_view
action.description: Capture the Scene view (default action).
action.param: Output file (the actual path is returned)

param.name: view
param.note: current | all | cardinal | iso | top | front | right | back | left | bottom

action.param: Frame one GameObject: {focusobject: hierarchy path, index: 0-based sibling index}
Animated GIF instead of PNG: {frameCount, fps, colorCount, startDelay}
Capture N frames, stepping S simulation frames between each

action.name: capture_scene_camera
action.description: Capture the scene camera (same renderer and parameters as capture_scene_view).

param.name: view
param.note: current | all | cardinal | iso | top | front | right | back | left | bottom

action.param: Frame one GameObject: {focusobject: hierarchy path, index: 0-based sibling index}
Animated GIF instead of PNG: {frameCount, fps, colorCount, startDelay}
Capture N frames, stepping S simulation frames between each

action.name: capture_main_camera
action.description: Capture Camera.main.

param.name: width
param.note: default: the camera's pixel width (960 if unavailable)

param.name: height
param.note: default: the camera's pixel height (540 if unavailable)

action.param: Animated GIF instead of PNG: {frameCount, fps, colorCount, startDelay}
Capture N frames, stepping S simulation frames between each
Allow a static capture in Play Mode (requires static_reason)
Why a genuinely static Play Mode capture is acceptable

action.name: capture_specific_camera
action.description: Capture a named camera.

param.name: width
param.note: default: the camera's pixel width (960 if unavailable)

param.name: height
param.note: default: the camera's pixel height (540 if unavailable)

action.param: Animated GIF instead of PNG: {frameCount, fps, colorCount, startDelay}
Capture N frames, stepping S simulation frames between each
Allow a static capture in Play Mode (requires static_reason)
Why a genuinely static Play Mode capture is acceptable

action.name: capture_asset
action.description: Capture asset previews (GameObject/Prefab, Mesh, Material, Texture2D, Sprite). Edit Mode only; as_gif is not supported.
action.param: .unity scene to stage the assets in (opened additively, closed when the capture finishes)

param.name: view
param.note: all | cardinal | iso | top | front | right | back | left | bottom

param.name: width
param.note: default: the Scene view camera's pixel width (960 if unavailable)

param.name: height
param.note: default: the Scene view camera's pixel height (540 if unavailable)

action.name: capture_ui_toolkit
action.description: Capture a UI Toolkit panel (.uxml). Edit Mode only.

param.name: width
param.note: default: the main Game View width capped at 960

param.name: height
param.note: default: the main Game View height capped at 540

action.name: start_game_view_recording
action.description: Start a Game View MP4 recording (requires ffmpeg; Play Mode).

param.name: encodeFps
param.note: clamped 1-30; defaults to fps; alias: encode_fps

action.param: MP4 metadata frame rate — how fast a model samples the video
Seconds to wait before the recording starts

action.name: finish_game_view_recording
action.description: Finish a Game View MP4 recording and get the file.

tool.description: Input simulation in Play Mode: virtual device lifecycle, mouse, keyboard, text entry, step sequences (coroutines across frames).

action.name: create_virtual_devices
action.description: Create the virtual mouse/keyboard (disables real devices while active). Required before keyboard input and non-UI mouse actions.

action.name: destroy_virtual_devices
action.description: Destroy the virtual devices and restore the real ones.

action.name: mouse_click
action.description: Click at a screen position (origin bottom-left, Y up).

action.name: mouse_move
action.description: Move the mouse to a screen position.

action.name: mouse_drag
action.description: Drag from one position to another.

action.name: mouse_scroll
action.description: Scroll at a screen position.

action.name: mouse_down
action.description: Press and hold a mouse button (pair with mouse_up).

action.name: mouse_up
action.description: Release a held mouse button.

action.name: key_press
action.description: Tap a key for one frame (requires input init).

action.name: key_down
action.description: Hold a key down (pair with key_up).

action.name: key_up
action.description: Release a held key.

action.name: type_text
action.description: Type text into the focused uGUI/TMP input field (no Input System required).

action.name: sequence
action.description: Run an ordered list of input steps (JSON array).
action.param: Frames to wait before the first step

tool.description: Click buttons on native modal dialogs blocking the editor main thread (runs on the background command pump).

action.name: click
action.description: Click a button on an open modal dialog (Save Scene, compile errors, ...).
action.param: Only click dialogs whose title matches (regex)

tool.description: Inspect or cancel Bridge jobs (thread-safe; works while the main thread is blocked by a dialog).

action.name: list
action.description: List tracked jobs (attached + detached).

action.name: status
action.description: Get the status of one job (action alias: check).

action.name: cancel
action.description: Request cancellation of a running job.

tool.description: List the live catalog of Bridge tool types, actions and client timeout budgets (this command).
